header.function_name: X3 Crossdock Master Setting - Mapping per Destination

objective: To split the Max Case/Day of each Active part over destinations (Thailand, Japan, Vietnam) for the ongoing calculation period.
To display the destination mapping per part and calculation period, including past periods (read only).
To hand changed parts to the RPA, which sends them to the global system, and show the Sync Status of each part.
To export the mapping to Excel and upload the mapping of the ongoing period from Excel.
This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account; users with a Procurement account open the Part List sub-menu instead.

items.name: Calculation period
items.description: Options: All periods / every calculation period; the ongoing one is marked '(ongoing)'. The label shows (ongoing) / (past) / (all). Calculation periods are created by the calculation batch; the latest period created is the ongoing period and earlier ones become past. A new period starts empty: the mapping of the previous period is not copied. Every Active part is listed with its Max Case/Day from Part List (the quota) but no destination yet (Total Case/Day 0, 0%), until the D/S user assigns it by Edit mapping or Upload Excel.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account.
Search criteria: 'Calculation period' = ongoing period, 'Part Number' blank, 'Sync Status' = No Sync.
Ongoing period: list every Active part of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, with its destinations of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST for that period (a part without destinations is listed with Total Case/Day 0).

A new period starts empty: the mapping of the previous period is not copied. Every Active part is listed with its Max Case/Day from Part List (the quota) but no destination yet (Total Case/Day 0, 0%), until the D/S user assigns it by Edit mapping or Upload Excel.
Past period: list every part that has rows in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST for that period, whatever its current status. 'All periods' lists both.
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list.
'Part Number' matches by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Calculation period' and 'Sync Status' match exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
[Upload Excel] and Export Excel follow the period of the applied criteria.
If no row matches, hide the table and display message no. 1.
With the default Sync Status = No Sync, parts that are Success or Failed are hidden until the filter is changed.
Total Case/Day = sum of CASE_DAY of the part and period; Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x Total Case/Day.
Percentage = Total Case/Day / Max Case/Day; it never exceeds 100% because the total can not go above Max Case/Day (Save, upload and the Max Case/Day edit in Part List are blocked).

The list is paged: 25 rows per page by default (25 / 50 / 100), with paging information and [Prev] / [Next]. A part with its Destination Mapping panel counts as one row. [Search], Reset and a change of Rows per page return to page 1.
User clicks the arrow on a row: open the panel with the allocation chip, the note and the destination table (Destination, Case/Day, Pcs/Day, Percentage). All items are read only.
Ongoing period: show [Edit mapping]. Past period: show message no. 5 instead; the mapping cannot be changed.
A part without destination shows message no. 2.
Copy the mapping into a draft; Destination and Case/Day become editable, a trash icon appears per row and [Add destination] is shown.
The Destination list hides destinations already used by another row of the same part (one destination per part).
[Add destination] adds a row with 'Select destination' and Case/Day 0.
[Split evenly] (more than one row): Case/Day of each row = floor(Max Case/Day / number of rows); the remainder is added +1 per row from the first row. Example 24 / 3 = 8 / 8 / 8; 25 / 3 = 9 / 8 / 8.
The allocation chip and note are recalculated on every change.
the total Case/Day is above Max Case/Day (show message no. 3);
the part has no destination row; or
a row has no destination selected (show message no. 4).
A total below or equal to Max Case/Day is allowed; below is shown as '{n} case/day left'.
If the mapping was changed by another user after edit mode started, display message no. 8. Stop.
Replace the rows of the part and the ongoing period in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST by the rows of the draft (refer Data Edit Mapping).
Set SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync) in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, so the D/S user synchronises the part again.
Insert a history record per added, changed or removed destination in TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (event MAPPING, source SCREEN, DEST_CODE, FIELD_NAME CASE_DAY, old / new Case/Day).
Leave edit mode and show the saved mapping.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or closes the panel: discard the draft.

items: Select every Active part of the ongoing period with Sync Status No Sync or Failed, whatever the search criteria show (n of the button). Candidate and Inactive parts are never synchronised.
Set SYNC_STATUS = 3 (Waiting) for these parts in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and start the RPA function. Display message no. 10.
With the default filter No Sync the parts leave the list; select Sync Status = Waiting or All to follow them.

operation.text: RPA function (the global system has no interface, so an RPA enters the data).

items: For each Waiting part, read Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and all destinations with Case/Day of the ongoing period from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST.
Replace the data of the part in the global system with this complete set, so a change such as Japan up and Thailand down, or a removed destination, arrives as one consistent update.
Write the result back to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: SYNC_STATUS = 1 (Success) or 2 (Failed), SYNC_DT and SYNC_MESSAGE (reason when Failed).
If the part was changed after the RPA read it (CHANGED_DT differs), set SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync) instead of Success, so the newer data is sent by the next Sync.
Record every part in TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (event SYNC, source RPA, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, new status, REMARK = SYNC_MESSAGE).

operation.text: A Failed part shows SYNC_MESSAGE as tooltip on its chip (message no. 11) and is included again in the next [Sync].
TBD: RPA function details (global system screens, run time, behaviour when the RPA is not available).

items: [Upload Excel] is enabled only when the ongoing calculation period is selected; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 6 as tooltip.
The modal shows the template columns (part_no, dest_code, case_day, total_case_day), the upload rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Base file: sheet 'Upload' of Export Excel with the ongoing period selected. A part in the file gets its whole mapping replaced; parts not in the file are not changed.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "Crossdock Master Setting - Mapping per Destination Upload".
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 7. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts show Sync Status No Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Mapping_per_Destination_<period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (<period> e.g. Sep_2026 or All_periods).

Sheet 'Mapping per Destination': rows of the active filter, one row per destination (a part without destination gives one row with blank destination columns). Columns: Period, Part Number, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Total Case/Day, Pcs/Day, Percentage, Sync Status, Destination Code, Destination, Dest Case/Day, Dest Pcs/Day, Dest Percentage. Information only.

Sheet 'Upload': every Active part of the ongoing period with part_no, dest_code, case_day, total_case_day (= Max Case/Day); one row per destination, and one row with dest_code and case_day blank for a part without mapping. Empty when a past period or All periods is selected.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 9.

operation.text: Sync Status is kept per part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE because the RPA sends a part as one set (Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and all destinations). Every mapping change and every Sync result is recorded in the history table TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (with the period).

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (RPA user ID for SYNC)
Date and time of the change
